verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a business banking platform (e.g., batch bill payments, mass card issuance, bulk transaction categorization), but the evidence never documents selecting many items and acting on them at once. The closest items are adjacent features rather than bulk actions: deposit-splitting auto-transfer rules, a cap of 50 cards, and recurring invoices. A community report adds that external payments still have to be executed manually.
